up: Retrieve activity records for compound CHEMBL95 and all its salts/derivatives. First, identify the molregno for CHEMBL95 from molecule_dictionary. Use molecule_hierarchy to find all related molregnos where parent_molregno equals the CHEMBL95 molregno (include the parent itself). Filter activities to those linked to these molregnos, with standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM', targeting CHEMBL220. Join assays to get assay_description and tid, then join target_dictionary on tid to filter for chembl_id = 'CHEMBL220' and retrieve target_chembl_id (chembl_id), target_name (pref_name), and target_organism (organism). Join compound_records to get compound_key and doc_id, then join docs to get pubmed_id and doi. Combine these into pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id if present, otherwise use doi). Join compound_structures to get canonical_smiles. Return exactly: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH parent_mol AS (
    SELECT molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary
    WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL95'
),
related_mols AS (
    SELECT molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy
    WHERE parent_molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM parent_mol)
    UNION
    SELECT molregno FROM parent_mol
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE
    a.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM related_mols)
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL220';
